subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should OpenClaw accept leader-verified direct-PID fallback for omitted Unix cleanup callers in this process-tree helper, or require a different caller-state-only contract before merge?
rationale: The code fix is coherent, but it intentionally changes default cleanup semantics for existing omitted-option callers and can trade gateway safety for descendant cleanup when group leadership cannot be verified.

options.title: Accept Guarded Cleanup
options.body: Resolve conflicts and CI, then land the current leader-check fallback with explicit `detached: true` forwarding for known detached-spawn callers.

options.title: Require More Caller Audit
options.body: Ask for additional caller-state proof or forwarding changes before merge if maintainers know omitted callers that must always group-kill.

options.title: Choose Caller-State Only
options.body: Reject this shape and keep the fix in explicit caller propagation if maintainers do not want helper-side leader checks or synchronous process inspection.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Cleanup
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts and CI, then land the current leader-check fallback with explicit `detached: true` forwarding for known detached-spawn callers.
